meta.note: Canonical promote/retire state untouched. Applying any decisions below is an owner decision.

run_params.ci_level_note: 99.375% CI per candidate (Bonferroni for 8 candidates). Wider than the 4-candidate run which used 98.75% CI.

buy_hold.note: Equal-weight across 8 symbols, daily bars, last 700 eval bars, fee=0.001

candidates.name: MACD/RSI
candidates.note: Too few trades (9 across 8 symbols x 700 bars). Sharpe below B&H. CI wide and lower bound negative.

candidates.name: EMA Crossover
candidates.note: Closest to promotion: both halves positive, 128 trades, drawdown well below B&H (-39% vs -67%). Fails only because CI lower bound (-0.93) is below zero. Consistent with earlier runs showing Sharpe diff ~0.4 but wide interval.

candidates.name: Stochastic
candidates.note: Extreme drawdown (-261%) from near-zero equity under all-in (95%) sizing across losing symbols. Wide CI. Sharpe below B&H. Inconsistent halves.

candidates.name: GBM (LightGBM)
candidates.note: Negative Sharpe. Walk-forward OOS AUC 0.477-0.540 across symbols (near-random). Not retired because CI upper (1.62) > 0.

candidates.name: MACD/RSI + Trend
candidates.note: Trend filter reduces MACD/RSI to only 5 total trades. Effectively flat. Very low drawdown (-2.6%) but unobservable in this window. Prior expectation confirmed: drawdown reduces, Sharpe edge not established.

candidates.name: EMA Crossover + Trend
candidates.note: Trend filter reduces EMA Crossover Sharpe from 0.882 to 0.571, drawdown from -39% to -15%. CI far too wide. Inconsistent across halves. Confirms prior: drawdown reduction does not produce Sharpe edge.

candidates.name: Stochastic + Trend
candidates.note: Trend filter reduces Stochastic drawdown from -261% to -107%, but -107% still fails the B&H+5% tolerance (B&H -67%). Positive point estimate but CI far too wide. Inconsistent halves.

candidates.name: GBM + Trend
candidates.note: GBM + Trend worse in Sharpe than GBM alone (-0.730 vs -0.506). Drawdown improves from -56% to -40%. Not retired because CI upper (2.06) > 0.

summary.closest_to_promotion: EMA Crossover (fails only CI lower bound; all other promotion criteria pass)
run_notes: n_boot=500 used instead of default 2000 for speed. Intervals approximate; conclusions unlikely to change given width.
Bonferroni widening from 4 to 8 candidates: CI level moves from 98.75% to 99.375%, making the lower-bound test marginally harder.
Stochastic's -261% drawdown is a backtest artifact from near-zero equity under all-in sizing, not a realistic outcome.
MACD/RSI + Trend's 5 total trades (8 symbols x 700 bars) makes it essentially unobservable in this window.
No strategy was in paper trading before this run; no forward P&L to report.
